import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"change_event_status\":{\"name\":\"Pending\",\"mapped_to_status\":\"closed\",\"show_in_select\":true,\"default_status\":true}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/change_events/statuses/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

get.description: List Change Event statuses for a specified project.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

default_status.description: Whether this status is flagged as the company default applied to new Change Events.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Change Event status. Pass as the status filter id when filtering Change Events by status.

mapped_to_status.description: Internal lifecycle status this Change Event status maps to. Drives Procore's built-in behavior regardless of the customizable display name.

name.description: Display name of the status. Company-customizable; for built-in default statuses this is the localized label of the mapped_to_status.

show_in_select.description: Whether this status is available for selection in the UI.

403.description: User does not have permission to access Change Event statuses.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
